notes: 2026-08-13 update: Pointed DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION backend from deployed http://172.16.0.12/api/decisionops-pod1/p0/cdm to local backend http://127.0.0.1:8000/p0/cdm.

2026-08-13 migration: ONE unified upload endpoint (connector as a form field) replaces the four separate per-connector upload routes (/connectors/<connector>/upload) for documents, timeseries, and sap. pnid was deliberately NOT migrated — it still posts to its own /connectors/pnid/upload via src/app/api/domain-configuration/pnid/[...path]/route.js.

2026-08-13 CORRECTION (live 422): connector=documents does NOT use the `file_type` field name — the backend rejected it with {"success": false, "message": "document_type is required when uploading documents.", "errors": [{"field": "document_type", "message": "document_type is required."}]}. documents keeps its OLD field name `document_type` even on the new unified endpoint; only timeseries (`file_type`: metadata|values, confirmed) and sap (`file_type`: SAP, confirmed) use `file_type`.

2026-08-17 update — confirmed live via Network tab (connector=documents, 200 success) + Swagger UI for POST /p0/cdm/connectors/upload: (1) `connector` enum now natively includes aif/gloc/lopc/pnid alongside documents/timeseries/sap — per explicit user decision this app migrated AIF/GLOC/LOPC feed uploads off connector='sap'+file_type=<feed> onto their own native connector value ('aif'/'gloc'/'lopc', lowercased from FEED_TYPES at the call site in useConfigModalActions.handleFeedSubmit); pnid was explicitly NOT migrated (stays on its dedicated /connectors/pnid/upload route — no live-tested request against this endpoint for pnid yet). (2) New required field `labels` (except pnid) — the four fixed use-case values integrity|reliability|maintenance|production, comma-joined or repeated, LOWERCASE (this app's old FILE_LABEL_OPTIONS values were capitalized — fixed in admin.constants.js). (3) New optional field `files_meta` — per-file JSON `[{file_name, labels}]` for batches where files carry different labels; built by the new connectorsService.buildUploadLabelFields() helper and wired into every submit path (documents, sap, timeseries metadata/values, feeds). (4) The old app convention of collapsing all files' labels into a single `document_type_label` field (only the FIRST file's labels, discarding the rest) was a bug — `document_type_label` has been removed from every submit path; it is NOT the same thing as `labels` (its real purpose is unconfirmed — Swagger shows it as an optional string|null field, sent empty in the live-captured request, no description text was legible in the provided screenshot). (5) `source_columns` also appears as an optional field on this endpoint per Swagger, but the live-captured request left it blank and this app still sets source_columns via the separate updateUserConfig() call — left unchanged, not sent on the upload request itself.

2026-08-17 KNOWN GAP — RESOLVED (see the GET /connectors/labels entry below): ConfigModal.jsx's handleGlobalDocSubmit (the 'Upload & Sync All' footer button, which batches ALL pending docFiles across every doc subtype in one go) used to send no `labels` at all, because docFileLabels was local state inside useDocSourceModal.js. Fixed on 2026-08-17 by lifting docFileLabels into shared AdminForm state (useDocsFormState.js → useAdminContextValues.js), so both doc submit paths read the same filename→labels map; handleGlobalDocSubmit now appends labels + files_meta via buildUploadLabelFields, and its button stays disabled until every queued file is labelled. Consequence of the lift: resetDocModalState() no longer wipes the whole map on modal close (files queued under other subtypes must keep their labels) — labels are dropped per file on removal, per batch on per-subtype submit, and wholesale after a global submit.

2026-08-17 unconfirmed vs current app taxonomy: user-supplied confirmed document_type values are equipment_datasheets, incident_reports, cause_effect_matrix, sop, startup_shutdown, operating_manuals, log_sheets, batch_reports, maintenance_manuals, rca_reports, hazop, jsa_jha, msds_sds, erp_plan, ptw. This list does not explicitly include `inspection_reports` or `other_files`, both of which exist in this app's DOC_TYPE_CATEGORIES/DOC_ROW_KEYS (admin.constants.js / useSourceTabs.js) and are still wired up in the UI. Most likely explanation is a copy/paste omission (inspection_reports vs incident_reports look alike and incident_reports appears twice in the pasted list), not a real backend removal — left the UI taxonomy untouched since removing either would delete working functionality on a guess. Flag to the user if either type starts getting rejected live.

endpoints.description: Unified upload endpoint for documents, timeseries, sap, and the natively-typed aif/gloc/lopc feeds. connector distinguishes the target instead of a URL segment. pnid is a valid value per Swagger but this app does not route pnid uploads through it (see notes).

connector.confirmed: documents confirmed live 2026-08-17; timeseries/sap confirmed 2026-08-13; aif/gloc/lopc confirmed via Swagger enum dropdown only (not yet live-tested by this app)
values: pnid (Swagger-only — this app does not send it here)

document_type.note: connector=documents ONLY. Field name is document_type, NOT file_type.
document_type.values: any DOC_TYPE_CATEGORIES key — see notes above for the backend-confirmed subset vs this app's fuller taxonomy (inspection_reports/other_files unconfirmed).

file_type.confirmed: 'metadata'/'values' confirmed live for connector=timeseries; 'SAP' confirmed for connector=sap
file_type.note: connector=timeseries and connector=sap ONLY. AIF/GLOC/LOPC no longer use file_type as of 2026-08-17 — they use their own native connector value instead.

labels.note: Required on every connector except pnid. Comma-joined string or repeated field, lowercase. Vocabulary: integrity | reliability | maintenance | production (GET /connectors/labels returns the canonical list). This app sends the union of every uploaded file's selected labels here, and the true per-file breakdown in files_meta.

files_meta.note: Optional JSON array, one object per uploaded file: [{"file_name": "a.pdf", "labels": ["integrity"]}]. file_name must match the uploaded file's name. Used whenever files in a batch carry different labels (this app always sends it when any label is set, via connectorsService.buildUploadLabelFields). Per-file document_type override is also supported by the backend schema but unused by this app (documents are always uploaded one document_type per batch).

document_type_label.note: Present in Swagger as optional string|null; sent empty in the only live-captured request. Purpose not confirmed — do NOT reuse for the use-case labels concept, that's `labels`/`files_meta`. This app no longer sends this field (previously misused for the per-batch label, now fixed).

source_columns.note: Present in Swagger as optional string, sent empty in the live-captured request. This app still manages source columns via the separate updateUserConfig() call, not via this field — left unchanged.

data.connector: string (present on the aif example response; not observed on the documents response)
data.labels: string[] (present on the aif example response)
data.target_table: string (present on the aif example response)
data.files: array — per file: name, size, status, labels, metadata {kind, extension, content_type, size_bytes, page_count?, has_text_layer?, pages?[], sheets?[]}, duplicate_of, is_duplicate, duplicate_matched_on, content_hash, flow_uid, stage

responseShape.note: Response shape expanded materially on 2026-08-17 (per-file metadata detail, duplicate detection). This app currently only reads data.job_id from the response — none of the new fields (accepted_count, rejected_count, is_partial, duplicate detection) are surfaced in the UI yet. Not built out — flagged as a possible follow-up, not implemented here (out of scope of the endpoint-contract fix).

endpoints.description: The fixed use-case label vocabulary rendered by every connector upload modal, plus which connectors require a label and what the backend suggests per connector. Added 2026-08-17 (user-supplied contract + UI screenshot). This is the ONLY source of the list — the app's hardcoded FILE_LABEL_OPTIONS array in admin.constants.js was deleted, per explicit user decision that there be NO local fallback.

plant_code_id.note: Not declared in the supplied contract (the payload is global reference data), but sent per CLAUDE.md Rule 0, which overrides Swagger for plant-scoped domains. FastAPI ignores unknown query params, so this is safe; drop it only if the endpoint is ever confirmed to reject extras.

data.labels: array — per label: { key (the value sent in `labels`/`files_meta`, lowercase), label (display text), colour ('green'|'blue'|'amber'|'purple'), sort_order (number — render order) }
data.required_for: string[] — connectors whose upload MUST carry labels. Contract sample: ['documents','timeseries','sap','aif','gloc','lopc']
data.suggested: object — connector -> label keys to pre-tick. Returned but DELIBERATELY UNUSED by this app: per explicit user decision (2026-08-17) the user selects labels themselves for every data source, so nothing is pre-ticked.

responseShape.note: Envelope is stripped by connectorsService's unwrap(); the query hook's `select` then sorts labels by sort_order and maps colour -> a semantic-token dot class (green->bg-success, blue->bg-info, amber->bg-warning, purple->bg-brand) so the picker follows the active theme instead of a hardcoded palette.
